abstract: We propose a measure of the valuation gap between debt and equity—debt‐equity spread (DES)—based on the difference between actual and equity‐implied credit spreads. DES predicts cross‐sectional stock and bond returns in opposite directions. This predictability is unique compared to existing mispricing measures and cannot be explained by exposures to various risk factors. High‐DES firms are more likely to issue equity and retire debt, and have more insider equity selling. These findings are consistent with DES capturing relative mispricing between debt and equity, and provide empirical support for the model of partially segmented markets in Greenwood, Hanson, and Liao (2018, Review of Financial Studies 31, 3307–3343).
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量债务与股权估值差距的指标——债务-股权利差（DES），该指标基于实际信用利差与股权隐含信用利差之间的差异。DES能够反向预测股票和债券的横截面收益。这种预测能力相较于现有的错误定价指标具有独特性，且无法通过各类风险因子的暴露来解释。高DES企业更倾向于发行股票并偿还债务，同时内部人股权出售行为更为频繁。这些发现与DES捕捉债务与股权相对错误定价的结论一致，并为Greenwood、Hanson和Liao（2018，《金融研究评论》第31卷，第3307–3343页）提出的部分分割市场模型提供了实证支持。

abstract: Can monetary incentives improve health behaviors in the long run, and do commonly used surrogate outcomes capture these effects? We study these questions in the context of vaccination using a large-scale eld experiment. The experiment combines commonly used surrogates|vaccination intentions, intermediate behavioral proxies, and short-run vaccination|with long-run administrative vaccination records. We first document that incentives increase vaccination rates in the long run: guaranteed $20 incentives raise COVID-19 booster uptake by 9 percentage points. Lottery-based incentives also increase long-run uptake, while prosocial incentives primarily accelerate vaccination. Second, using surrogacy methods, we study whether surrogates can predict long-run impacts. Although the surrogates are strongly correlated with eventual vaccination, the assumptions required for surrogacy methods are often violated, and they do not accurately predict long-run impacts. Our ndings highlight both the ability of incentives to change behavior and the importance of measuring long-run outcomes rather than relying solely on surrogates.
abstract_zh: 货币激励能否长期改善健康行为？常用的替代指标能否捕捉这些效应？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，以疫苗接种为背景研究上述问题。该实验将常用替代指标（疫苗接种意愿、中间行为代理变量及短期疫苗接种）与长期行政疫苗接种记录相结合。首先，我们证实激励措施能长期提升疫苗接种率：20美元保证性激励使新冠加强针接种率提高9个百分点。基于抽奖的激励同样能提升长期接种率，而亲社会激励主要加速疫苗接种进程。其次，通过替代指标方法，我们检验替代指标能否预测长期影响。尽管替代指标与最终疫苗接种存在强相关性，但替代指标方法所需假设常被违反，且无法准确预测长期影响。研究结果既凸显了激励措施改变行为的能力，也揭示了测量长期结果而非仅依赖替代指标的重要性。
title: Incentives, Surrogates, and Long-run Vaccination
title_zh: 激励、替代指标与长期疫苗接种

abstract: Model averaging has garnered significant attention in recent years for its ability to combine information from multiple models. A critical challenge in frequentist model averaging is determining the appropriate weight vector. The bootstrap method, well-known for its desirable properties, offers a promising solution. In this article, we propose a bootstrap model averaging approach that selects weights by minimizing a bootstrap-based criterion. Notably, our weight selection criterion can also be interpreted as bootstrap aggregating. When all candidate models are misspecified, we show that the resulting estimator is asymptotically optimal, achieving the minimum possible squared error loss. Furthermore, we establish the convergence rate of the bootstrap weights toward the theoretically optimal weights. In scenarios where correct candidate models exist within a nested set and the number of covariates is fixed, we derive the limiting distribution of our proposed model averaging estimator. Through simulation studies and empirical applications, we demonstrate that our proposed method often outperforms other commonly used model selection and model averaging techniques, and other bootstrap-based variants.
title: Bootstrap Model Averaging

abstract: This paper examines how bank behavior contributes to capital misallocation from the supply side, leveraging China's 2008 fiscal stimulus as a quasi-experimental setting. Using proprietary loan-level data from a major state-owned bank, we document systematic credit misallocation favoring state-owned enterprises (SOEs) over private firms. Following the stimulus announcement, the bank reduced interest rates significantly more for SOEs than for comparable private enterprises-a differential reduction of 0.36 standard deviations-despite SOEs exhibiting higher default rates and unchanged credit ratings. We identify the mechanism as a loosening of risk-based pricing: interest rates became less sensitive to internal credit ratings for SOEs. This risk-based pricing misallocation largely relates to the industrial policy in supporting government-preferred industries. Notably, no such distortion appears in bankers' acceptances, a less-regulated shadow banking activity, suggesting policy intervention-not financial frictions-drives the observed misallocation. Our findings provide direct micro-level evidence on how government directives and industrial policy induce capital misallocation through weakened credit risk management in state-owned banks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国2008年财政刺激政策作为准自然实验，从供给侧探讨银行行为如何导致资本错配。基于一家大型国有银行的专有贷款数据，我们记录了系统性信贷错配现象，即信贷资源偏向国有企业而非私营企业。在刺激政策宣布后，该银行对国有企业的利率下调幅度显著大于可比私营企业——差异达0.36个标准差——尽管国有企业违约率更高且信用评级未变。我们识别出的机制是风险定价的放松：国有企业的利率对内部信用评级的敏感度下降。这种风险定价错配在很大程度上与支持政府偏好产业的产业政策相关。值得注意的是，在银行承兑汇票（一种监管较少的影子银行活动）中并未出现此类扭曲，这表明政策干预而非金融摩擦驱动了所观察到的错配现象。我们的研究为政府指令和产业政策如何通过削弱国有银行信用风险管理而导致资本错配提供了直接的微观层面证据。

abstract: Abstract Geopolitical tensions have increasingly extended to the development of strategic technologies. In particular, technological rivalry between the United States and China has reshaped firms’ international innovation networks and the organization of research and development activities. Patent data from leading 5G firms indicate that the effects of geopolitical fragmentation are strongest among firms whose innovation networks were previously highly integrated across geopolitical blocs. In these firms, the increase in geopolitical fragmentation is associated with a reduction of approximately 2.1 percentage points in the likelihood of collaboration between cross-block inventors, equivalent to roughly one quarter of the average level of collaboration. Geopolitical fragmentation also reduces inventor team diversity and the participation of inventors from rival geopolitical blocs. The effects were the broadest among Chinese firms. The findings suggest that geopolitical rivalry affects not only trade, investment, and technology transfer but also innovation networks through which new technologies are developed. In strategic industries such as 5G, geopolitical fragmentation may narrow the channels of international knowledge exchange and reshape the structure of global innovation networks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 地缘政治紧张局势已日益延伸至战略技术的发展领域。特别是，美国与中国之间的技术竞争重塑了企业的国际创新网络以及研发活动的组织方式。来自领先5G企业的专利数据表明，地缘政治碎片化的影响在那些此前创新网络高度跨地缘政治阵营整合的企业中最为显著。在这些企业中，地缘政治碎片化的加剧与跨阵营发明者之间合作可能性的降低约2.1个百分点相关，这相当于平均合作水平的约四分之一。地缘政治碎片化还降低了发明者团队的多样性以及来自对立地缘政治阵营发明者的参与度。这些影响在中国企业中最为广泛。研究结果表明，地缘政治竞争不仅影响贸易、投资和技术转让，还影响新技术开发的创新网络。在5G等战略产业中，地缘政治碎片化可能收窄国际知识交流的渠道，并重塑全球创新网络的结构。

abstract: Personalized recommendation systems shape much of user choice online, yet their targeted nature makes separating out the value of recommendation and the underlying goods challenging. We build a discrete-choice model that embeds recommendation-induced utility, low-rank heterogeneity, and flexible state dependence and apply the model to viewership data at Netflix. We identify recommendation-induced engagement from observational variation in algorithmic exposure, treating exposure as conditionally exogenous given observed user, good, and state characteristics. Separately, we estimate model-free diversion ratios from a randomized experiment that perturbs recommendations and use these to assess the validity of the structural model. We use the model to evaluate counterfactuals that quantify the incremental engagement generated by personalized recommendations. First, we show that replacing the current recommender system with a matrix factorization or popularity-based algorithm would lead to a 4% and 12% reduction in engagement, respectively, and decreased consumption diversity. Second, most of the consumption increase from recommendations comes from effective targeting, not mechanical exposure, with the largest gains for mid-popularity goods (as opposed to broadly appealing or very niche goods).
abstract_zh: 个性化推荐系统在很大程度上塑造了用户的在线选择，但其针对性特征使得分离推荐本身的价值与所推荐商品的价值颇具挑战。我们构建了一个离散选择模型，该模型融合了推荐引致的效用、低秩异质性以及灵活的状态依赖性，并将此模型应用于Netflix的观看数据。我们通过算法曝光中的观测变异来识别推荐引致的参与度，将曝光视为在给定观测到的用户、商品及状态特征条件下的条件外生变量。此外，我们利用一项随机实验来估计无模型依赖的转移比率，该实验对推荐进行扰动，并以此评估结构模型的有效性。我们运用该模型评估反事实情境，量化个性化推荐所产生的增量参与度。首先，我们表明，若将当前推荐系统替换为矩阵分解或基于流行度的算法，参与度将分别下降4%和12%，且消费多样性也会降低。其次，推荐带来的消费增长大部分源于有效的目标定位，而非机械性曝光，其中中等流行度商品（相对于广泛吸引力或极为小众的商品）获益最大。
title: The value of personalized recommendations: Evidence from Netflix
title_zh: 个性化推荐的价值：来自Netflix的证据

abstract: Although the environmental impact of trade has been a long-standing concern, there is still scant evidence on the channels through which international market access affects pollution. We exploit the unique episode of China’s world market integration in the early 2000s to provide direct empirical evidence on three such mechanisms, corresponding to each pollution scope: direct pollution at firms’ locations (scope-1), indirect pollution from energy generation (scope-2), and indirect pollution from the supply chain (scope-3). We combine granular satellite data on air pollution with detailed information on manufacturing firms and coal power plants, and leverage exogenous foreign demand shocks for identification. Three main findings emerge: exporting firms reduce local pollution; pollution levels around coal power plants rise due to regional export shocks; and upstream suppliers reduce pollution in the face of export demand shocks to downstream firms. Our findings point to China’s reliance on coal power plants to fuel its export-driven growth as one of the main drivers of the rise in pollution.
abstract_zh: 尽管贸易对环境的影响一直是长期关注的焦点，但关于国际市场准入如何影响污染的渠道证据仍然匮乏。我们利用21世纪初中国融入世界市场的独特时期，为三种机制提供了直接的经验证据，这些机制分别对应不同的污染范围：企业所在地的直接污染（范围1）、能源生产的间接污染（范围2）以及供应链的间接污染（范围3）。我们将高分辨率的卫星空气污染数据与制造业企业和燃煤电厂的详细信息相结合，并利用外生外国需求冲击进行识别。主要发现有三点：出口企业减少了当地污染；区域出口冲击导致燃煤电厂周边污染水平上升；面对下游企业的出口需求冲击，上游供应商减少了污染。我们的研究结果表明，中国依赖燃煤电厂来支撑其出口导向型增长，是污染加剧的主要驱动因素之一。

abstract: Increasing rates of urbanisation, high unemployment and the absence of social security in developing countries are putting pressure on urban households' diets, prompting some to advocate urban agriculture as a fallback. Because households voluntarily choose to engage in urban agriculture, it is important to account for the self‐selection inherent in practising urban agriculture when evaluating the efficacy of urban agriculture in cushioning urban households' diets. Accordingly, we estimate the effects of practising urban agriculture on household dietary diversity using the endogenous switching model with a count outcome (ESMC) based on four pooled annual cross‐section surveys of Zimbabwean households from 2019 to 2023. We employ propensity score matching (PSM) as a secondary robustness check, acknowledging that it addresses selection only on observed characteristics. We offer three major findings. First, large households, and households headed by women, older heads and those that are married and living together with their spouses are ceteris paribus more likely to practise urban agriculture. Second, practising urban agriculture increases the likelihood that urban households will have greater dietary diversity. Third, urban agriculture improves dietary diversity only for the sub‐population of households that do not receive support from rural relatives. The findings of this study confirm the potential role of urban agriculture in improving the food and nutrition security of urban households without support from relatives in rural areas in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家城市化率上升、高失业率及社会保障缺失正对城市家庭膳食结构造成压力，促使部分学者倡导将城市农业作为应对策略。由于家庭自愿选择参与城市农业，在评估其对城市家庭膳食的缓冲作用时，必须考虑参与行为固有的自选择偏差。为此，本研究基于2019至2023年津巴布韦家庭四轮年度截面调查数据，采用计数结果内生转换模型（ESMC）估计城市农业实践对家庭膳食多样性的影响。我们以倾向得分匹配法（PSM）作为稳健性检验的辅助方法，但需承认该方法仅能解决可观测特征导致的选择偏差。研究得出三项主要发现：第一，在其他条件不变的情况下，大家庭、女性户主家庭、年长户主家庭及已婚同居家庭更可能从事城市农业；第二，参与城市农业能显著提升城市家庭膳食多样性的概率；第三，城市农业仅对未获得农村亲属支持的家庭子群体具有改善膳食多样性的效果。本研究证实，在发展中国家缺乏农村亲属支持的城市家庭中，城市农业对改善其粮食与营养安全具有潜在作用。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Urban Agriculture Adoption, Diet Variety and Rural Support Among Urban Zimbabwe Households
title_zh: 津巴布韦城市家庭的城市农业采纳、饮食多样性与农村支持

abstract: We build on Modestino et al., who analysed “opportunistic upskilling” during the 2007 recession in the US, by extending their approach to European labour markets following recent economic shocks. Using a comprehensive dataset of online job postings (2019–2023) and an instrumental variable approach leveraging Ukrainian refugee inflows, we find that increases in labour supply have a significant positive effect on both education and experience requirements. Our findings reinforce the idea that employers opportunistically upskill labour demand in different but challenging macroeconomic contexts. The identification of such patterns, however, depends on the presence of a plausibly exogenous shock to labour markets.
abstract_zh: 我们基于Modestino等人对2007年美国经济衰退期间“机会性技能提升”的研究，将其方法拓展至近期经济冲击后的欧洲劳动力市场。利用2019-2023年在线招聘信息的综合数据集，并采用以乌克兰难民流入为工具变量的方法，我们发现劳动力供给增加对教育及经验要求均产生显著正向影响。研究结果进一步印证了雇主在不同但严峻的宏观经济背景下会机会性地提升劳动力需求技能水平的观点。然而，此类模式的识别依赖于劳动力市场是否存在合理外生冲击。
title: Opportunistic Upskilling in European Labour Markets—Evidence From a Wide Replication
title_zh: 欧洲劳动力市场中的机会性技能提升——基于广泛复制的证据

abstract: In this paper, we consider the relationship between poultry processing industry concentration and labor costs at the industry level using plant-level data for all poultry processing facilities in the U.S. We find that plant acquisition by an industry leader firm generates an increase in future sales-per-employee at the plant in subsequent periods. Increased ownership concentration at both the national and state-level leads to a reduction in poultry processing worker renumeration, relative to the compensation for comparable jobs in other sectors. Relative to concentration and consolidation levels 25 years ago, these developments have led to between $37 and $710 million in additional revenues per year and between $27 and $218 million savings in the aggregate wage bill for the four largest poultry firms, implying a 2.6–12.0% increase in the gross labor margin for these firms.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国所有家禽加工设施的工厂层面数据，考察了家禽加工业集中度与行业层面劳动力成本之间的关系。我们发现，行业领军企业对工厂的收购会导致该工厂后续期间人均销售额的增加。在全国及州层面的所有权集中度提高，相对于其他部门类似工作的薪酬，会导致家禽加工工人报酬的减少。与25年前的集中度和整合水平相比，这些发展已使四大禽肉企业每年额外获得3700万至7.1亿美元的收入，并在总工资账单上节省了2700万至2.18亿美元，这意味着这些企业的总劳动利润率提高了2.6%至12.0%。
title: The effects of U.S. poultry industry consolidation on employee productivity and labor costs
title_zh: 美国禽业整合对员工生产率与劳动力成本的影响

abstract: Flattening government hierarchies not only reduces organizational layers but also restructures fiscal capacity, reshaping both local growth incentives and regional redistribution. This paper identifies a fundamental trade-off: while flattening promotes equalization across regions, it simultaneously undermines economic efficiency at the local level. We develop a multi-tier government model showing that reallocating fiscal authority upward enlarges common revenue pools, which enhance redistribution but dilute local governments’ incentives to foster growth. Empirically, we exploit China’s staggered Province-Managing-County (PMC) reform as a quasi-natural experiment and apply a stacked difference-in-differences strategy to county-level panel data from 2000 to 2007. We find that the PMC reform significantly reduced intra-provincial inequality—measured by Gini, Theil, and related indices—but concurrently lowered county GDP per capita. Reductions in physical investment and firm-level productivity, rather than shifts in labor input, drove the efficiency loss. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that provinces with stronger fiscal pooling (higher VAT-sharing ratios) and broader administrative spans experienced a more severe equalization–efficiency trade-off. Our findings extend fiscal federalism and organizational structure theories by showing how hierarchy flattening and fiscal pooling jointly shape the balance between redistribution and local economic performance.
abstract_zh: 扁平化政府层级不仅减少了组织层级，还重构了财政能力，从而重塑了地方增长激励与区域再分配格局。本文揭示了一个根本性的权衡：扁平化在促进区域间均等化的同时，也削弱了地方层面的经济效率。我们构建了一个多层政府模型，表明将财政权力向上重新配置会扩大共同收入池，这增强了再分配效应，但稀释了地方政府促进增长的激励。在实证方面，我们利用中国分阶段推行的“省直管县”（PMC）改革作为准自然实验，并采用堆叠双重差分策略分析2000至2007年的县级面板数据。研究发现，PMC改革显著降低了省内不平等——以基尼系数、泰尔指数及相关指标衡量——但同时降低了县级人均GDP。效率损失主要源于物质投资和企业层面生产率的下降，而非劳动力投入的变化。异质性分析表明，财政统筹程度更强（增值税分享比例更高）和行政管辖范围更广的省份，其均等化—效率权衡更为严峻。我们的研究拓展了财政联邦主义和组织结构理论，揭示了层级扁平化与财政统筹如何共同塑造再分配与地方经济绩效之间的平衡。

title: Flattening governments, flattening growth: Equalization–efficiency trade-off in jurisdictional reform
title_zh: 扁平化政府与扁平化增长：辖区改革中的均等化-效率权衡

abstract: This study investigates how deeply rooted collectivist culture, stemming from historical rice farming practices, shapes individuals’ willingness to pay (WTP) for environmental protection in China. Using data from the China General Social Survey (CGSS), we examine the relationship between the proportion of rice farming in a province – a proxy for collectivism – and stated environmental WTP. Our findings reveal that regions with a higher prevalence of rice farming exhibit a significantly greater environmental WTP, consistent with the hypothesis that collectivism fosters stronger pro-environmental preferences. The effect is strongest among individuals with low intrinsic public spirit, revealing a ‘cultural compensation’ mechanism whereby external norms of shared responsibility substitute for weak internal altruism. It is further amplified in regions facing more severe pollution pressures but weakens in areas with a higher share of migrants from low-collectivism regions, underscoring both the persistence of historical cultural influences. These findings extend the ‘rice theory’ to contemporary environmental behaviour and highlight the enduring role of culture in shaping environmental preferences. For policymakers, this suggests that while collectivist cultural values should be recognized as important contextual factors in environmental policy design, formal environmental policies also play a crucial role in complementing or even substituting the influence of collectivist culture.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了源自历史水稻种植实践的根深蒂固的集体主义文化如何塑造中国个体对环境保护的支付意愿（WTP）。利用中国综合社会调查（CGSS）数据，我们考察了省份水稻种植比例——作为集体主义的代理指标——与陈述性环境支付意愿之间的关系。研究发现，水稻种植比例较高的地区表现出显著更高的环境支付意愿，这与集体主义促进更强亲环境偏好的假设相一致。这一效应在内在公共精神较低的个体中最为显著，揭示了一种“文化补偿”机制，即外部共享责任规范替代了薄弱的内在利他主义。该效应在面临更严重污染压力的地区进一步增强，但在来自低集体主义地区移民比例较高的地区则有所减弱，凸显了历史文化影响的持续性。这些发现将“水稻理论”拓展至当代环境行为，并强调了文化在塑造环境偏好中的持久作用。对政策制定者而言，这表明在环境政策设计中，集体主义文化价值观应被视为重要的背景因素，同时正式的环境政策在补充甚至替代集体主义文化影响方面也发挥着关键作用。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: From rice to responsibility: collectivism and environmental willingness to pay in China
title_zh: 从稻米到责任：中国的集体主义与环境支付意愿

abstract: We use the monthly data of geopolitical risk (GPR) and financial markets, including stock, bond, and exchange rate markets in 23 countries between January 2013 and June 2023, and employ a multilayer nonlinear network to accurately capture and analyse the complex, interrelated dynamics between geopolitical risks and financial markets. The results indicate that geopolitical risk events alter the pattern of financial risk connectedness. During periods of geopolitical stress, GPR becomes the primary risk transmitter, displacing the stock market as the dominant source of risk spillovers. Although GPR is normally more closely associated with the stock market, during major geopolitical events its influence shifts towards the bond market with a noticeable lag. Major economies and geopolitical focal countries serve as key risk spillovers, while other emerging economies primarily act as risk recipients.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2013年1月至2023年6月间23个国家的月度地缘政治风险（GPR）与金融市场数据，涵盖股票、债券及汇率市场，并采用多层非线性网络，以精确捕捉并分析地缘政治风险与金融市场之间复杂且相互关联的动态关系。研究结果显示，地缘政治风险事件改变了金融风险关联模式。在地缘政治紧张时期，GPR成为主要风险传递者，取代股票市场成为风险溢出的主导来源。尽管GPR通常与股票市场联系更为紧密，但在重大地缘政治事件期间，其影响转向债券市场，并伴有明显的滞后效应。主要经济体和地缘政治焦点国家作为关键的风险溢出源，而其他新兴经济体则主要扮演风险接收者的角色。
title: Impact of geopolitical risk on global financial market connectedness: evidence from dynamic analysis based on multilayer nonlinear network
title_zh: 地缘政治风险对全球金融市场关联性的影响：基于多层非线性网络动态分析的证据

abstract: The rise of the gig economy has reshaped workforce structures and challenged traditional Human Resource Management (HRM) models, making it crucial to understand managers’ perspectives on integrating freelancers – an area still underexplored, especially in emerging economies. This study addresses this gap by examining Romanian managers’ perceptions of hiring freelancers, using unique survey data. Drawing on the theoretical foundations of Person-Organization Fit theory and Human Capital theory, following rigorous econometrical analysis, this research shows that managers’ desire to engage freelancers is influenced not only by technical expertise but also by cultural fit, value alignment, knowledge, and willingness to share knowledge within organizational teams. Furthermore, demographic (age, gender) and industry-level differences significantly shape managerial attitudes. These insights contribute to HRM scholarship by advancing theory on managerial decision-making in relation to non-standard work arrangements, with direct practical implications.
abstract_zh: 零工经济的崛起重塑了劳动力结构，并对传统人力资源管理（HRM）模式构成挑战，这使得理解管理者对整合自由职业者的看法变得至关重要——这一领域在新兴经济体中仍探索不足。本研究利用独特的调查数据，通过考察罗马尼亚管理者对雇佣自由职业者的认知来填补这一空白。基于人-组织匹配理论与人力资本理论的理论基础，经过严谨的计量经济学分析，本研究表明，管理者聘用自由职业者的意愿不仅受技术专长影响，还受文化契合度、价值观一致性、知识水平及在组织团队内分享知识的意愿所驱动。此外，人口统计学特征（年龄、性别）及行业层面的差异显著塑造了管理者的态度。这些见解通过推进关于非标准工作安排中管理者决策的理论，为人力资源管理学术研究作出贡献，并具有直接的实际应用意义。
title: Integrating freelance talent in organizations: insights from managers
title_zh: 组织整合自由职业者人才：来自管理者的洞见

abstract: This study proposes a Macroeconomic Auto-Regressive Random Forest (MARRF) model to complement existing methods for forecasting annual U.S. food price inflation. Leveraging the flexibility of ensemble machine learning and the interpretability of Generalized Time-Varying Parameters (GTVPs), the MARRF model integrates high-dimensional macroeconomic information extracted from the FRED-MD database to produce forecasts that are both accurate and economically informative. Out-of-sample evaluation over 2003–2024 reveals that despite informational inefficiencies, the MARRF and SARIMA exhibit complementary strengths. Forecast encompassing tests confirm that each model captures distinct information, and simple averaging of the two yields both bias reduction and accuracy improvement across the full forecast cycle—outcomes neither model achieves on its own. Furthermore, variable importance metrics and time-varying parameters reveal shifting macroeconomic drivers of food price inflation across time and forecast horizons.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种宏观经济自回归随机森林（MARRF）模型，以补充现有方法，用于预测美国年度食品价格通胀。该模型结合了集成机器学习的灵活性与广义时变参数（GTVPs）的可解释性，整合了从FRED-MD数据库提取的高维宏观经济信息，从而生成既准确又具有经济信息量的预测。2003年至2024年的样本外评估显示，尽管存在信息效率不足，MARRF与SARIMA模型展现出互补优势。预测包含检验证实，各模型捕捉了不同的信息，而两者的简单平均在整个预测周期内既降低了偏差又提升了准确性——这是任一模型单独无法实现的结果。此外，变量重要性指标和时变参数揭示了食品价格通胀的宏观经济驱动因素在不同时间和预测期限上的动态变化。
title: Food price inflation forecasting: Insights from a Macroeconomic Auto-Regressive Random Forest approach
title_zh: 食品价格通胀预测：基于宏观经济自回归随机森林方法的洞见

abstract: We study how U.S. dollar fluctuations transmit through domestic supply chains in emerging markets. Large firms borrow in foreign currency and extend trade credit to domestic partners, exposing the supply chain to exchange rate risk. We develop a model where financially constrained suppliers pass through shocks to buyers, while unconstrained firms absorb them. Using quarterly firm-level data from 19 emerging markets, we provide empirical evidence consistent with the model’s predictions. We find that even highly exposed firms reduce trade credit only modestly following a depreciation, while accepting large profit losses, suggesting that firm-to-firm credit relationships partially shield downstream firms from financial shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了美元波动如何通过新兴市场的国内供应链传导。大型企业借入外币并向国内合作伙伴提供贸易信贷，使供应链面临汇率风险。我们构建了一个模型，其中受财务约束的供应商将冲击传递给买家，而财务不受约束的企业则吸收这些冲击。利用19个新兴市场的季度企业层面数据，我们提供了与模型预测相符的经验证据。我们发现，即使在贬值后，高度暴露的企业也仅适度减少贸易信贷，同时承受较大的利润损失，这表明企业间的信贷关系在一定程度上保护了下游企业免受金融冲击的影响。
title: Firm-to-firm financial linkages and dollar risk transmission
title_zh: 企业间金融联系与美元风险传导

abstract: This article examines the ontological foundations of two major strands within the field of public choice: the Virginia school, led by James M. Buchanan, and the Bloomington school, represented by Elinor and Vincent Ostrom. Although their early collaboration was guided by a shared ambition, we argue that any attempt to subsume these two strands under a single theoretical framework is problematic. It risks overlooking a fundamental ontological divide regarding the nature of collective action and the so-called ‘constitutional moment.’ Buchanan’s framework, centered on exchange among rational individuals and the principle of unanimity, sharply contrasts with the Ostroms’ institutionalist approach, which emphasizes reciprocity and the formation of “communities of shared understanding” as the basis of collective action. These ontological differences underpin distinct methodological commitments to individualism, and ultimately entail important nuances in their approaches to public governance. Whereas Buchanan focuses on protecting individual liberty from government intrusion, the Ostroms highlight individuals’ capacity to engage directly in the governance of the public sector. In sum, since differences emerge at a fundamental level of their theoretical frameworks, any attempt to integrate them inevitably risks a reductive interpretation. Bloomington, after all, is not in Virginia.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了公共选择领域中两大主要流派的本体论基础：以詹姆斯·M·布坎南为首的弗吉尼亚学派，以及以埃莉诺和文森特·奥斯特罗姆为代表的布卢明顿学派。尽管他们早期的合作源于共同的抱负，但我们认为，任何试图将这两大流派纳入单一理论框架的做法都是有问题的。这可能会忽视关于集体行动本质及所谓“立宪时刻”的根本性本体论分歧。布坎南的理论框架以理性个体间的交换及一致同意原则为核心，与奥斯特罗姆夫妇的制度主义路径形成鲜明对比，后者强调互惠以及“共享理解社群”的形成作为集体行动的基础。这些本体论差异支撑了各自对个体主义方法论的不同承诺，并最终在其公共治理方法上体现出重要细微差别。布坎南侧重于保护个体自由免受政府干预，而奥斯特罗姆夫妇则强调个体直接参与公共部门治理的能力。总之，由于这些差异出现在其理论框架的根本层面，任何整合尝试都不可避免地面临简化解读的风险。毕竟，布卢明顿并非弗吉尼亚。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Why Bloomington is not in Virginia: Contrasting the social ontologies, methodologies, and governance theories of the Ostroms and Buchanan
title_zh: 为何布卢明顿不在弗吉尼亚：奥斯特罗姆与布坎南的社会本体论、方法论及治理理论之对比

abstract: We present a model of frictional lending where entrepreneurs choose their outside options (self-finance or waiting to find other lenders) when bargaining with banks. When the number of banks is sufficiently small, the equilibrium features self-finance as entrepreneurs’ dominant outside option; when the number of banks is sufficiently large, waiting becomes the dominant outside option. The model can rationalize the mixed empirical evidence on the relationship between banking concentration and loan-rate markups. It also uncovers new policy-dependent channels through which the concentration-markup relationship need not be stable or positive. Depending on the equilibrium regime, monetary policy can alter entrepreneurs’ outside options and change how banking concentration affects loan market power. Our main insight extends to cases with endogenous entry of banks or entrepreneurs, prudential regulation, and default risk.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个摩擦性贷款模型，其中企业家在与银行谈判时选择其外部选项（自我融资或等待寻找其他贷款人）。当银行数量足够少时，均衡特征表现为自我融资成为企业家的主导外部选项；当银行数量足够多时，等待则成为主导外部选项。该模型能够解释关于银行集中度与贷款利率加成之间关系的混合经验证据。它还揭示了新的政策依赖渠道，通过这些渠道，集中度与加成之间的关系可能不稳定或非正相关。根据均衡机制的不同，货币政策可以改变企业家的外部选项，并影响银行集中度如何作用于贷款市场力量。我们的主要见解扩展至银行或企业家的内生进入、审慎监管以及违约风险等情形。
title: Banking concentration and loan-rate markups in a frictional loan market
title_zh: 摩擦性贷款市场中的银行集中度与贷款利率加成

abstract: We investigate optimal monetary and macroprudential policies in an open economy with aggregate demand externalities and an occasionally binding zero lower bound constraint. Our analysis highlights that the optimal policy balances output stabilization and capital flow management. When macroprudential policy is available, monetary policy stabilizes the output gap. By contrast, when macroprudential policy is not available, monetary policy is used prudentially. However, contrary to a widespread view, raising the interest rate is not necessarily the optimal prudential policy. Finally, we show that international spillovers operate through the world real rate, but macroprudential policies provide insulation from the adverse effects of foreign policies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在总需求外部性和零下限约束偶尔生效的开放经济体中，最优货币政策和宏观审慎政策的制定。我们的分析强调，最优政策需要在产出稳定与资本流动管理之间取得平衡。当宏观审慎政策可用时，货币政策用于稳定产出缺口。相反，当宏观审慎政策不可用时，货币政策被审慎地使用。然而，与普遍观点相反，提高利率并非最优的审慎政策。最后，我们表明国际溢出效应通过世界实际利率传导，但宏观审慎政策能够抵御外国政策的不利影响。
title: Liquidity Traps, Prudential Policies and International Spillovers
title_zh: 流动性陷阱、审慎政策与国际溢出效应
